findings.title: Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.recommendation: Review the policy for correctness and compatibility; presence alone does not guarantee a safe configuration.

findings.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.evidence: Final response URL is not HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: HSTS is delivered over HTTPS; configure HTTPS first, then review HSTS.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.recommendation: Review the policy for correctness and compatibility; presence alone does not guarantee a safe configuration.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.recommendation: Review the policy for correctness and compatibility; presence alone does not guarantee a safe configuration.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.recommendation: Review the policy for correctness and compatibility; presence alone does not guarantee a safe configuration.

findings.title: Framing protection
findings.evidence: X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors was observed.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the framing policy matches the site's intended embedding behavior.

findings.title: CORS configuration
findings.recommendation: Compare the allowed origin against the application's intended allowlist.

limitations: Only one GET request and one OPTIONS request are sent; this is not a crawler.
The scanner does not test authentication, authorization, application logic, injection, or exploitability.
Header presence is not proof that a policy is correctly configured.
CORS behavior may vary by endpoint and request; manual review is required.
Run only against systems you own or have explicit permission to assess.
